tools.name: Contra
tools.what: Commission-free portfolio marketplace and direct invoicing platform.
tools.why: 0% commission with per-payment fees on the free tier and Pro at about $29/month per fee comparisons (vendor pricing page not opened; $199 annual rate untested in T0-66).

tools.name: Fiverr
tools.what: Commodity gig marketplace.
tools.why: Flat 20% seller service fee confirmed (downgraded from T0-66 A-on-Extract S77 to B; live-verified 2026-11-19); T0-18 found AI strategy listed at $10-125/hr and agent builds ~$295, unsuitable for senior AI consulting.

tools.name: Fractional Jobs
tools.what: Job board for fractional roles and sponsor of a large multi-function fractional survey.
tools.why: Fees remain unverified: vendor page was not retrieved and competitor sources conflict ('no platform fees' vs a 'one-time fee'). Confirm fee and exclusivity terms directly before relying on it.

tools.name: Fractionus
tools.what: Managed fractional executive marketplace and external fractional job board.
tools.why: Hosts external listings (Apply opens the employer's post) alongside a managed network claiming <3% acceptance (vendor COI); its own blog describes an 80/20 split (20% talent-side cut). Confirm whether an engagement is direct or split-bearing before committing.

tools.name: Go Fractional
tools.what: Recruiter-led marketplace and job board for fractional executives; handles contracts, invoicing and payouts.
tools.why: Base operator signup is free (optional paid Pro tier explains competitor fee claims) with a $500 client-referral cash/credit bonus (live-verified 2026-11-19) and 7+/5+ year membership criteria. Live posting counts were unverifiable ('0 open roles' counter) and its $205/hr CAIO benchmark is vendor data (COI). Downgraded from T0-66 A-on-Extract to B.

tools.name: Toptal
tools.what: Vetted freelance talent network for engineering, product and finance contractors.
tools.why: 0% talent fee, 4-stage screen with 2-week paid client test (<3% stated acceptance), $79/month client subscription, estimated 30-60% client markup and a 24-month non-circumvention clause per a terms analysis (live-verified 2026-11-19). Read IP and direct-hire bars carefully.

tools.name: Upwork
tools.what: Open bidding marketplace for freelance contracts.
tools.why: Variable 0-15% freelancer service fee per contract since 2025-05-01 (live-verified 2026-11-19; one rival cites flat 10%) plus Connects costs. Utilisation filler only: per-contract gen-AI/creative earnings fell 13% while starts rose 90%.

tools.name: Canada Job Bank & ESDC Global Talent Stream Portal
tools.what: Official Canadian NOC prevailing-wage lookup (Job Bank) and ESDC Global Talent Occupations List and LMIA timing dashboard.
tools.why: Primary source for GTS Category A/B eligibility, C$1,000 fee, LMBP rules, annual prevailing wage updates, and measured GTS LMIA averages (9 business days in Sep 2026).

tools.name: DOL FLAG (PERM & Prevailing Wage Processing Times)
tools.what: Official US Department of Labor portal publishing monthly PERM analyst review and prevailing wage processing times.
tools.why: Primary authoritative clock for PERM queues (300-360 days analyst review as of 2026-10-31) and OEWS prevailing wage lookups required to assess wage-weighted H-1B tiers.

tools.name: Immigration petition providers (Deel Immigration/Legalpad, Manifest Law, Beyond Border Global, WeGreened/NAILG, VisaNation, Tukki, Alma)
tools.what: Firms that prepare US O-1 and EB-1 petitions or screen eligibility.
tools.why: Approval claims are self-reported (for example '98% approval' and '91% success under approval-or-refund'), and no independent audit of any provider's approval rate was found. Published fees include $6,999 to $12,500 (Manifest Law) and about $8k for an O-1 (Beyond Border Global); free eligibility screens exist. Pointers, not legal advice.

tools.name: Make it in Germany & Ireland DETE Employment Permits Portal
tools.what: Official federal portals for Germany EU Blue Card / Opportunity Card and Ireland Critical Skills Employment Permits (queue dates and CSOL).
tools.why: Primary sources for binding annual salary floors (Germany EUR 50,700 / 45,934.20; Ireland EUR 40,904 / 68,911), degree-free IT routes, and live DETE processing queue dates.

tools.name: Official immigration portals (USCIS, GOV.UK, Canada ESDC and IRCC, Singapore MOM, France-Visas, UAE)
tools.what: Government pages for criteria, fees and steps, plus official tools such as Canada's Job Bank wage search and Singapore's EP self-assessment tool.
tools.why: The primary sources behind every visa fact; provider pages and success stories are self-reported. T0-08 lists several items likely to change within six months, so re-read the official page on the day you act. Pointers, not legal advice.

tools.name: Singapore MOM Self-Assessment Tool (SAT) & ONE Pass Portal
tools.what: Official Ministry of Manpower portal for EP COMPASS scoring (including the AI Shortage Occupation List) and ONE Pass AI & Tech track eligibility.
tools.why: Primary source for Singapore's S$6,000 Jan 2027 EP floor, COMPASS C3 nationality-diversity check, and the 2027-01-28 ONE Pass AI & Tech track replacing Tech.Pass.

tools.name: Taiwan Employment Gold Card & Malaysia MDEC DE Rantau Portals
tools.what: Official application portals for Taiwan's unsponsored Employment Gold Card (Digital field) and Malaysia's DE Rantau Nomad Pass.
tools.why: Primary sources for Taiwan's NT$160k/month salary qualification and Malaysia's 2026-12-01 enhanced DE Rantau framework (USD 36k tech floor, up to 4 years, no appeals).

tools.name: UK Register of Licensed Sponsors (Workers) & Tech Nation Portal
tools.what: Official GOV.UK Skilled Worker sponsor register and Tech Nation Global Talent Digital Technology endorsing-body portal.
tools.why: Lets candidates verify whether a UK employer holds an active Worker sponsor licence and check official Global Talent endorsement criteria directly without relying on inflated vendor pass-rate claims.

tools.name: US Department of State Visa Bulletin & Wait Times
tools.what: Monthly US immigrant visa cut-off dates (Final Action and Dates for Filing) and consular interview wait-time tool.
tools.why: Essential monthly reference for India EB-1/EB-2/EB-3 priority queues and Indian consular post wait times; automated bots are blocked so inspect directly in a browser.

tools.name: US O-1A / EB-1A / NIW Commercial Retainer Vendors (e.g., WeGreened, Beyond Border)
tools.what: Commercial immigration law firms and concierge platforms marketing O-1A, EB-1A, and EB-2 NIW filings with 91%-99% approval headlines.
tools.why: Published approval rates reflect pre-screened refund cohorts without public denominators and diverge sharply from USCIS FY2026 Q3 baselines (32.2% EB-1A, 55.3% NIW); demand written criterion-by-criterion screens.
tools.status: changed: heightened scrutiny under USCIS PA-2026-05

tools.name: Bonsai
tools.what: Contracts, proposals, invoices and time tracking for independents.
tools.why: $15, $25, $39 or $59 per user a month ($9–49 billed yearly); proposals, contracts and invoicing start at the Essentials plan, and processing fees vary by payment method. T0-18 did not review its template wording.

tools.name: Stripe Invoicing
tools.what: Card and bank-debit invoicing.
tools.why: 0.4% (Starter) or 0.5% (Plus) per paid invoice, plus card and bank-debit processing fees charged separately. Prices were read on Stripe's Bulgaria page; a US page was not fetched.

tools.name: Payoneer
tools.what: Cross-border receiving accounts with automated withdrawal to a local Indian bank.
tools.why: Local receiving free, non-local 1%, INR withdrawal up to 3%, $29.95 annual fee if receipts fall below $6,000, and 48-hour auto-withdrawal (B). Payoneer India received in-principle RBI PA-CB authorisation on 2026-01-22, but final Certificate of Authorisation was not verified as of November 2026; verify live status on RBI's list.
tools.status: unverified: final RBI PA-CB licence pending after 2026-01-22 in-principle approval

tools.name: PayPal (for freelance export invoices)
tools.what: Consumer and business online payments service.
tools.why: Roughly 7.4–8.4% plus $0.30 fixed payment friction for India-based exporters (4.4% fee plus 3–4% FX spread, third-party guides, C). Avoid for B2B consulting invoices.

tools.name: Skydo
tools.what: India-focused cross-border export invoicing and collection rail with automated FIRA.
tools.why: Press and vendor reports confirm final RBI PA-CB-I (inward) authorisation in January 2026 (B, subject to RBI ₹25 lakh per-transaction cap). Flat-fee structure ($19 minimum, $29 on $10k) and instant FIRA generation are vendor-claimed (C, COI); check RBI's official list before relying.
tools.status: changed: final RBI PA-CB-I reported Jan 2026 (subject to ₹25L per-tx cap)

tools.name: Wise Business (India)
tools.what: Cross-border receiving rail converting foreign export invoices directly into INR.
tools.why: Terms of Use (2026-07-24) and fee schedule (2026-11-13), read directly in T0-43, state RBI PA-CB authorisation for export payments only (business proof required), ₹25L per-tx cap, automatic INR remittance (no holding balance), receiver reversal risk and FX fee + 18% GST. Fee page lists free eFIRC vs $2.50 in older help; new USD details unavailable for some accounts.
tools.status: changed: ₹25L per-tx PA-CB cap; export-only auto-remittance; USD details restricted for some accounts

tools.name: GST Portal (India)
tools.what: India's GST portal for registration, annual Rule 96A LUT filing, GSTR-1/3B returns and export refunds.
tools.why: Mandatory registration above ₹20L aggregate turnover (exports included) and annual LUT filing before the financial year's first export; Finance Act 2026 s.157 omitted IGST s.13(8)(b) from 2026-03-30, allowing qualifying intermediary services to export zero-rated under LUT. Pointers, not tax advice.

tools.name: Income Tax e-filing portal (India)
tools.what: India's official portal for Income-tax Act 2025 returns (effective 2026-04-01), AIS/TIS, advance tax and foreign tax credit.
tools.why: Official route for presumptive s.58(2) (formerly §44ADA) and regular returns plus s.408 advance tax. Core 2025 Act sections (s.58(2), s.58(4), s.62(4), s.63, s.408, s.124) were verified against official sources on 2026-11-19; new Income-tax Rules 2026 form numbers remain unverified. Pointers, not tax advice.

tools.name: RBI list of authorised payment system operators and PA-CB entities
tools.what: Reserve Bank of India register of authorised Payment Aggregators including Cross-Border (PA-CB) operators.
tools.why: Primary official check required before relying on any fintech export rail, especially under the RBI Master Directions on Regulation of Payment Aggregators (15 September 2025) enforcing the ₹25 lakh per-transaction PA-CB cap. Pointers, not legal advice.
